_readme: Affiliate offers injected into descriptions/comments by affiliates.py.
This file was missing — affiliates.py returned '' and the whole system was
dormant. TO GO LIVE: paste a real referral URL and set active: true.
concepts: ['*'] = every video, else charts.py concept keys.
MOBILE: links in Shorts comments/descriptions are NOT tappable in the app.
The only mobile-clickable surface is the CHANNEL PROFILE link — add each
active URL in Studio -> Customisation -> Basic info -> Links, and let the
spoken/pinned CTA point viewers to the channel page.
STRATEGY: quiz audience = 'I like testing myself / earning from my phone'.
Sign-up bounties (free to the viewer) are the only things that convert from
Shorts traffic — product/book links do not.
heading: For quiz lovers:
disclosure: Some links are referral links — the channel may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

offers.label: Swagbucks — earn gift cards answering polls & quizzes (free)
offers._signup: Flat ~$2.20 per free signup, near-zero approval bar. Best audience match: quiz viewers already like answering questions for fun.

offers.label: PrizeRebel — get paid for surveys (free to join)
offers._signup: Pays up to 30% of referred users' lifetime earnings — small per-user but recurring. Backup to Swagbucks; run one at a time.

offers.label: The trivia app we play between videos
offers._signup: MaxBounty / CPA-network app-install offers (trivia & casual games pay per install). Requires network approval — apply with the channel URL once it has a week of uploads.
